entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling because I'd like to start a return for a helmet I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The online pictures made the color look a bit different than it is in person. I never even used it; the box is still unopened.
I see, that can certainly happen. Do you have the order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 77 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I've checked our policy, and you're all set. Since it's within the 90-day return window, I can approve this for a full refund. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now.

That's great, I appreciate it. Now, since I do plan to buy a different model from your site, and I have to go through the trouble of shipping this back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad we could get the return processed for you. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns, the good news is you'll receive a full refund for the original purchase. And of course, your next helmet will be covered by our full warranty and safety guarantee.
I understand. What if we did store credit instead of a refund? Could you perhaps round up the credit amount as a gesture of goodwill?

We can definitely issue the refund as store credit if you'd prefer, but the amount would be for the exact purchase price. I'm afraid my system is strict on that and won't allow me to add any extra credit.
Okay, that's fair. A full refund to my card is fine then. Thank you for checking for me.
You're very welcome. The return label should be in your inbox. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
